plan.summary: PKT-12 Review Rescue AI Faz 4: Dashboard — RescueDashboardPage.tsx with KPI cards (total risks, rescued, failed, rescue rate, reviews posted), risk table with inline editing (status + strategy), template manager CRUD, and sidebar navigation entry. Frontend-only — all Backend proxy routes already exist from Faz 1-3.
plan.q_intent: PKT-12 Faz 4: Rescue dashboard sayfasi. KPI kartlari, risk tablosu (filtre + inline edit), sablon yonetimi (CRUD).
plan.interview_notes: Session continuation — clear scope from session prompt. Frontend-only, no backend changes needed. Existing proxy routes cover all rescue endpoints.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: RescueDashboardPage.tsx exists with KPI cards showing: total risks, pending, rescued, failed, rescue rate %, reviews posted
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: RescueKpiCards component renders 6 KPI cards from RescueStatsResponse data

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Risk table displays all review risks with risk level and status badges, inline editing for rescueStatus and rescueStrategy
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: RiskTable component with Pencil edit button, select dropdowns for status/strategy, save/cancel actions calling api.updateRescueRisk

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Risk table has filter dropdowns for riskLevel and rescueStatus that re-fetch data on change
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: filterLevel and filterStatus state in main page, passed to api.listRescueRisks, fetchAll re-triggers on filter change via useCallback dependency

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Template manager with create, edit, toggle active, and delete operations using existing /rescue/templates endpoints
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: TemplateManager component: openCreate, openEdit, handleSubmit (create/update), handleToggle (isActive), handleDelete. Form with templateName, riskLevel, strategy, messageTemplate, maxDiscountPct fields

acceptance_criteria.criterion: App.tsx has lazy-loaded /rescue route and Layout.tsx sidebar has 'Review Rescue' nav item with ShieldAlert icon under Pazarlama section
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: App.tsx: lazy import RescueDashboardPage, Suspense-wrapped route. Layout.tsx: ShieldAlert import, nav item with feature='Marketing', tenantLabel='Yorum Kurtarma'

acceptance_criteria.criterion: api.ts has typed interfaces and methods for rescue stats, risks CRUD, templates CRUD matching Marketing backend DTOs
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: 8 new API methods + 7 new TypeScript interfaces in api.ts. Field names match MarketingRepository DTOs (camelCase JS ↔ PascalCase C# via System.Text.Json)

files_changed.change: NEW: Full rescue dashboard with KPI cards, risk table (inline edit), template manager CRUD, tab navigation

Added 8 rescue API methods + 7 TypeScript interfaces (RescueStatsResponse, ReviewRiskResponse, RescueRiskUpdateRequest, RescueTemplateResponse, RescueTemplateCreateRequest, RescueTemplateUpdateRequest)
Added lazy import RescueDashboardPage + /rescue route with Suspense
Added ShieldAlert import + Review Rescue nav item in Pazarlama section

verification_questions.question: Do all api.ts TypeScript interfaces correctly match the C# DTO field names via camelCase conversion?
Does the rescue dashboard correctly handle empty state (no risks, no templates) without console errors?
Is the template form properly validating required fields (templateName, messageTemplate) before allowing submission?

intentional_exclusions: Follow-up status tab (requires cross-tenant endpoint not proxied through Backend)

user_facing_errors: Error card displayed with red border when API calls fail
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All API errors caught in fetchAll and displayed to user via error state card
